title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
lineage: SBD > MSR > C > DAT > CD > EAC > shntool > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Ragged yet compelling 1970 show with a monster The Other One → Lovelight jam, though the soundboard mix over‑emphasizes Bob Weir early on.
ai_review.review: The performance shines in its second‑half improvisations – a scorching The Other One into an extended Turn On Your Lovelight, plus tight China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, Black Peter and beautiful High Time. The soundboard recording is usable but suffers from an uneven mix that pushes Bob Weir far forward (especially early) and buries the drums, with balance improving after Bear’s solo.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong musical praise across ten reviews outweighs recurring mix‑balance issues; most reviewers give 4‑star ratings and one gives 5, indicating a solid overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bob Weir dominates the right channel and is mixed too high early on; drums are low/inaudible at times. Mix balances out after Bear's solo, but occasional channel dominance and a few cuts in The Other One are noted.

standout_songs: The Other One → Turn On Your Lovelight
China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
That's It (segment of The Other One)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical early‑1970 set with a slightly ragged first half that smooths out into a powerful second half; jams are creative but interspersed with standard, muscle‑memory playing. Overall the show feels gritty yet enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great guitar tone, especially audible on China Cat and at the end of Cold Rain.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass becomes more present after the mix settles; praised for being clearer later in the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythm guitar is mixed far too high early, making every note (and mistake) crystal clear – a treat for Weir fans.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are low/inaudible at the start but become more audible after mix adjustments; noted as a bit long‑winded in the Drums segment.
